fact: Decree (Premier Ministre) n° 2022-009 on electronic exchanges between users and administrative authorities and between administrative authorities, published in Journal Officiel n° 1505 after the Council of Ministers heard it on 3 November 2021, applies to any information exchanged electronically between administrative authorities and sets a security reference (RGS) their information systems must meet; the document gives only the year 2022 from the decree number, and its text is an excerpt that stops inside Article 4.
